plan_profiles: any admitted build-70450 plan with the wowdbdefs-70450-v1 catalogue
output: one new deterministic redacted JSON report; no package or DB2 files

reader_policy.other_declarations_and_builds: retain the 100000 direct-record, 100000 copy-pair, 100000 parent-entry, and 1000000 retained-value defaults unless another build-specific profile independently admits them

numeric_section_type_codes.0: regular WDC5 record variant; Header.Flags sparse bit clear
numeric_section_type_codes.1: sparse WDC5 record variant; Header.Flags bit 0 set

report.section_flags: numeric 0/1 indicating whether the section declares a nonzero TACT key lookup; the TACT value is not emitted
report.compression_kinds: sorted unique numeric ColumnMeta CompressionType codes in the strict decoder's accepted range 0..5; each value is read only from the u32 at byte offset +8 of its 24-byte ColumnMeta entry; unknown values are omitted and remain a reader rejection, so this field cannot contain arbitrary payload words

refusals.keys: --keys is refused before client or output access
refusals.output_inside_client_or_git_checkout: rejected by the shared guarded report-path check
refusals.non_70450_plan: rejected before opening the local store

inspection_only: Structural facts and the product DB2 validation classification are diagnostic; this command does not establish row-count parity, native parity, extraction completeness, or runtime compatibility.
